acceptanceCriteria: --help (global and per subcommand) prints usage and exits 0 without a pin; read-only listing verbs need no pin; the refusal names the missing flags --executable and --executable-sha256; tests cover each.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1327. `corvint-test-runner --help` and `profiles` print `runner refused: independent executable identity required` and exit 1; every subcommand except `runners` requires --executable and --executable-sha256, including help.
title: corvint-test-runner --help and read-only verbs refuse without an executable pin
